bio.text: Drew Echols, a Republican, was elected to the Georgia State Senate in 2024 and represents Senate District 49, which includes most of Hall County.
Echols is a graduate of East Hall High School, worked for Georgia Power for two and a half years, and then returned to Jaemor Farms, his family's farm.
Echols was president of the Hall County Farm Bureau from 2009 to 2014.
